instructions: Pappal is an Android-only React Native paid chat marketplace. Prioritize correctness, security, billing integrity, role isolation, lifecycle races, native API misuse, and missing regression tests. Do not request style-only churn.

rules.rule: Paid sessions, calls, wallet mutations, invoices, and request transitions must be server-authoritative, idempotent, role-checked, and safe under retries or concurrent clients.
Database changes must preserve RLS, least-privilege grants, immutable ledger/history records, and have pgTAP regression coverage.
Android-facing changes must cite the governing Android or AndroidX implementation documentation and add a mechanical assertion when possible.
Behavior changes and bug fixes need a regression test at the smallest stable seam; UI, motion, native SDK, and system-UI changes also need device-verifiable locators and states.
Generated files must be changed through their generator and source data, never hand-edited.
